title: Smoothie Stand Ratios
subject: math
instructions: Show your work where there's room. Write your ID number, not your name.

questions.prompt: Recipe Ratio: A smoothie uses 2 cups of mango for every 3 cups of yogurt. Fill in the table.
Unit Price: 6 smoothies cost $15. How much does 1 smoothie cost?
questions.key: Divides 15 by 6 (or finds the cost of 2 then halves, or a tape diagram) to get 2.50 dollars per smoothie.

questions.prompt: Plot It: Plot the points from the table, (2, 3), (4, 6), and (6, 9), as mango and yogurt cups. Connect them with a line.

diagram.description: A coordinate grid, first quadrant, x from 0 to 10 (mango, cups) and y from 0 to 12 (yogurt, cups), grid lines every 1 unit, labels every 2.

checklist.item: A straight line connects the points (and may extend through the origin).

questions.prompt: Same Taste? Which recipe tastes the same as 2 cups mango to 3 cups yogurt?

options.why: Adding the same amount changes the ratio.
1:2 has more yogurt for each cup of mango.
